headline: Furniture that
ages well
intro: Solid wood from the region, carpentry joints and oil finishes. Pieces for a lifetime, made in Olot since 1987.

categories.title: Dining and living room
categories.lead: Chairs, tables and shelves for a home that is lived in. Each piece is made to order; the usual lead time is six weeks.

products.name: Olot Chair
products.description: Solid oak with a rush seat, assembled without a single nail.

products.name: Besalú Table
products.description: Solid walnut with a one-piece top and legs joined with dovetails.

products.name: Sol Lamp
products.description: Turned walnut base and natural linen shade. Two-meter fabric cord.

products.name: Cal Stool
products.description: Round oak seat with three splayed legs. Stacks two at a time.

categories.title: Bedroom and study
categories.lead: For the entrance hall, the bedroom and the work corner. Every piece can be ordered in walnut or in oak, with the finish you prefer.

products.name: Fageda Bookcase
products.description: Walnut with five adjustable shelves and slotted sides. Fixes to the wall.

products.name: Mirador Bench
products.description: Hall bench with a seat upholstered in wool from local sheep.

products.name: Lluna Mirror
products.description: Oval mirror with a solid walnut frame and concealed hanging hardware.

products.name: Torre Desk
products.description: Oak with a three-drawer pedestal and cable outlet. Rounded edges.

woods.character: Dark, warm and with a strong grain
woods.finishes: Natural oil, beeswax, dark walnut stain
